verdict.rationale: Data storage location is a fair privacy question for an online IP filing and data service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any user-selectable storage region or residency option. The filing docs, the homepage items (including "gratuit et confidentiel") and the data.inpi.fr access probe do not address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
